units.source_text: 我把竖立在壁龛里的尺八拿了出来，将嘴唇贴在吹孔上，

en.t: I took out the shakuhachi standing in the alcove, and pressed my lips to the blowing hole,

units.source_text: 试吹奏了一支小练习曲，吹得很娴熟，使折回来的柏木吃一惊。

en.t: then tried playing a little etude; I played it so skillfully that Kashiwagi, returning, was startled.

units.source_text: 但是今晚的他，不是那天到金阁来时的他了。

en.t: But the man he was tonight was no longer the man who had come to the Golden Pavilion that day.
